item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:30 HKT 05/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China this morning. It will be windy over the region in the next couple of days. Under the influence of the monsoon, it will be generally fine and dry over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week and there will be slightly cooler mornings. Another replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China during the weekend. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Yinxing will intensify gradually and move towards the vicinity of Luzon Strait in the next couple of days. It will then have a higher chance to turn westwards and enter the central and northern parts of the South China Sea. Under the combined effect of the northeast monsoon and Yinxing, it will be windy over the south China coastal waters during the weekend and early next week.
